en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the AV room.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Play dominoes with the movie boxes
We should focus on reality, not movies

Then do you want some 
of my magic powder?

If you use this magic powder, you 
won't have to sleep for a few days.

This magic powder is all-powerful 
and great for dieting, too.

That seems like a lotta work, but maybe 
it'll help me think up a new spell...
I'll just watch, so have fun with it!

Why are you saying that so suddenly, 
like you just realized it?

D-Don't tell me you chanted a 
curse without me knowing!

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Himiko looks deep in thought...
